definitions.explanation: The annual income from an investment expressed as a percentage of its cost or current value. Used in finance for bonds, stocks, real estate, and other investments.

examples.japanese: この{債券|さいけん}の{利回|りまわ}りは{年|ねん}3%だ。
examples.english: The yield on this bond is 3% per year.

examples.japanese: {不動産|ふどうさん}{投資|とうし}では、{表面|ひょうめん}{利回|りまわ}りだけでなく{実質|じっしつ}{利回|りまわ}りも{確認|かくにん}すべきだ。
examples.english: In real estate investment, you should check not only the gross yield but also the net yield.

notes: A key term in finance and investing. Common collocations: {利回|りまわ}りが{高|たか}い/{低|ひく}い (high/low yield), {表面|ひょうめん}{利回|りまわ}り (gross yield), {実質|じっしつ}{利回|りまわ}り (net yield), {配当|はいとう}{利回|りまわ}り (dividend yield). Compound structure: {利|り} (profit, interest) + {回|まわ}り (rotation, return). Related: {利率|りりつ} (interest rate — for loans/deposits), {収益率|しゅうえきりつ} (rate of return — more formal).
